When_Violation_Created_Or_Updated.description: Triggers when a sharing violation record is created or updated with Open status (0).

Initialize_ViolationId.description: Capture the violation record ID from the Dataverse trigger.

Initialize_AgentId.description: Extract the Copilot Studio agent ID from the violation record.

Initialize_EnvironmentId.description: Extract the Power Platform environment ID from the violation record.

Initialize_RemediationMode.description: Default remediation mode is Approval for ALL governance zones (Non-Negotiable Rule #5). Auto-remediation only for PUBLIC_INTERNET_LINK when explicitly enabled.

Initialize_TeamsGroupId.description: Microsoft Teams team/group ID for remediation notifications. Set via environment variable fsi_UASD_TeamsGroupId.

Initialize_TeamsChannelId.description: Microsoft Teams channel ID for remediation notifications. Set via environment variable fsi_UASD_TeamsChannelId.

Get_Violation_Details.description: Retrieve the full violation record from Dataverse for remediation processing.

parameters.$filter: fsi_agent_id eq '@{variables('AgentId')}' and fsi_violation_type eq @{variables('ViolationType')} and fsi_exception_status eq 1 and fsi_expires_at ge @{utcNow()}

Check_Active_Exception.description: Query for an active, non-expired exception matching this agent and violation type.

Update_Violation_Exception_Granted.description: Update violation status to Exception_Granted (2) — active exception suppresses remediation.

items.text: A sharing violation was suppressed because an active, non-expired exception exists for this agent and violation type.

Compose_Exception_Found_Card.description: Compose notification card indicating the violation was suppressed by an active exception.

Post_Exception_Found_Notification.description: Notify the governance team that remediation was suppressed by an active exception.

Load_Sharing_Policy.description: Retrieve the active sharing policy to check whether auto-remediation is enabled for public links.

Set_RemediationMode_Auto.description: Override remediation mode to Automatic — only applies for PUBLIC_INTERNET_LINK (violation_type=1) when auto-remediation is explicitly enabled in the sharing policy.

Check_Auto_Remediation_Eligible.description: Auto-remediation is eligible ONLY when violation_type=1 (PUBLIC_INTERNET_LINK) AND fsi_auto_remediate_public_link is true. All other violations require Approval.

Load_Approved_Groups_Auto.description: Retrieve all active approved security groups from Dataverse for principal overwrite.

Build_Approved_Principals_Auto.description: Transform approved security groups into BAP-compatible principal objects for the PATCH body.

BAP_PATCH_Overwrite_Principals_Auto.description: CAUTION: Destructive operation. Overwrites ALL agent sharing principals with approved security groups via BAP Admin API. This removes all existing sharing and replaces with approved groups only.

Update_Violation_Remediated_Auto.description: Update violation status to Remediated (1) with auto-remediation timestamp.

items.text: A PUBLIC_INTERNET_LINK violation was automatically remediated. Agent sharing principals have been overwritten with approved security groups.

facts.title: Action Taken
facts.value: Principals overwritten with approved security groups

Compose_Auto_Remediation_Card.description: Compose adaptive card for auto-remediation notification.

Post_Auto_Remediation_Notification.description: Post auto-remediation completion notification to the designated Teams channel.

parameters.ApprovalCreationInput/itemLinkDescriptio: View in Power Platform Admin Center

Start_Remediation_Approval.description: Start an approval request for the remediation action. Assigned to the governance team. Default mode for ALL governance zones (Non-Negotiable Rule #5).

Load_Approved_Groups_Approved.description: Retrieve approved security groups for principal overwrite after approval.

Build_Approved_Principals_Approved.description: Transform approved security groups into BAP-compatible principal objects.

BAP_PATCH_Overwrite_Principals_Approved.description: CAUTION: Destructive operation. Overwrites ALL agent sharing principals with approved security groups via BAP Admin API.

Update_Violation_Remediated_Approved.description: Update violation status to Remediated (1) with approver name and timestamp.

items.text: A sharing violation remediation was approved. Agent sharing principals have been overwritten with approved security groups.

Compose_Approval_Complete_Card.description: Compose adaptive card for approved remediation notification.

Post_Approval_Complete_Notification.description: Post approved remediation notification to the designated Teams channel.

items.text: A sharing violation remediation request was rejected. The violation remains open for manual review.

Compose_Rejection_Card.description: Compose adaptive card for rejection notification.

Post_Rejection_Notification.description: Post rejection notification to the designated Teams channel.

Check_Approval_Outcome.description: Route remediation outcome based on approval response — apply changes if approved, leave open if rejected.

Remediation_Mode_Switch.description: Route remediation by mode: Automatic (PUBLIC_INTERNET_LINK only when enabled) or Approval (default for ALL zones — Non-Negotiable Rule #5).

Has_Active_Exception.description: Check whether an active, non-expired exception suppresses remediation for this violation.

Scope_Try.description: Main remediation scope: checks exceptions, determines remediation mode, and applies sharing policy changes via BAP API.

items.text: The Unrestricted Agent Sharing Detector remediation flow encountered an unexpected error during execution.

facts.title: Action
facts.value: Review flow run history in Power Automate portal

Compose_Error_Card.description: Compose error notification adaptive card for unexpected remediation flow failures.

Post_Error_Notification.description: Post error notification to the designated Teams channel when the remediation flow fails.

Scope_Catch.description: Error handling scope: catches unexpected failures in Scope_Try and sends CRITICAL notification to Teams.

properties.description: Remediates sharing violations by overwriting agent principals with approved security groups via BAP API. Default remediation mode is Approval for all governance zones (Non-Negotiable Rule #5). Auto-remediation available only for PUBLIC_INTERNET_LINK violations when explicitly enabled. Supports compliance with FINRA 4511/3110, SEC 17a-3/4, SOX 302/404. Part of the FSI Agent Governance — Unrestricted Agent Sharing Detector solution.
